rows.element: FetchUpdates and GetServices on a view restored from the cache (back navigation)
rows.os: the runtime ScreenStateCache restores the view; whether the AtStart data actions run again is runtime code, not in the app sources (U19)
rows.react: enterView hydrates the saved query data, then both queries fetch again (staleTime 0) and the read overrides apply on top
rows.note: Home Q3 (a): settled from the runtime code. A view restored from the cache gets its state back and then runs fireInitialize (OutSystemsReactView.js:7: fromImmutableData, viewWasRestoredFromCache = true, controller.fireInitialize(); :9 for the screen: viewWasRestoredFromCache passed to initialize). fireInitialize runs OnInitialize and then fetchData (OutSystems.js:17), and innerFetchDataWithDependencies resets the dependencies and fetches every ready source with no check of the restore (:17). The only reader of the flag is the public API wasCurrentViewRestoredFromCache (OutSystems.js:16); HomeFeed.mvc.js and FeedBlock_Updates.mvc.js do not read it. So TST runs FetchUpdates and GetServices again on a restored HomeFeed, as React does after enterView. A read-only capture (open an update, Back, watch the two calls) can confirm it. | capture 2026-10-27 (review/captures.md §5): after Back to HomeFeed, DataActionFetchUpdates and DataActionGetServices run again (+118 ms), as React does
